purpose: Real-orientation excitation-error (Sg) golden: pins the native per-orientation reciprocal-basis geometry (reciprocal_cell(cell @ M.T) -> g -> Sg) against an independent implementation on real quartz orientation matrices. M is non-orthonormal (folds the measured-vs-ideal cell correction, ~1% anisotropic), so g0 @ M^-1 is faithful while g0 @ M.T is wrong by ~0.008 A^-1.
